en: Every harbour that has crowned a Champion sends a boat here now. Some days the quay is a forest of masts!
I came over from Hoenn this morning, and tomorrow I'm off to Unova. This town is everybody's halfway house.
Nobody here keeps Badges of their own. The town goes by the rules of the furthest place you've been crowned in.
So a Pokémon that heeds you there heeds you here too. Handy, eh?
They say the big halls round here will open one by one. I want to be first through every door!
Pennant Hall's open at last: stalls from every region under one roof. We hung the last pennant this morning!
